# WoW Train (glosx.app)

> Free AI-powered train travel planner for Europe. Describe a trip in plain language and get a complete rail itinerary — routes, journey times, operators and booking links — covering rail travel across 16 European countries, with 103 individual route guides. No account, no signup. Independent project by GLOSX, not affiliated with any rail operator.

WoW Train is a website, not a mobile app. Bookings are completed on partner platforms (Klook and others); WoW Train never processes payments itself and earns a small affiliate commission at no extra cost to the traveler.

## Core

- [Homepage / AI trip planner](https://glosx.app/): describe a trip in plain language, get a full itinerary with connections and booking links
- [AI Planner (dedicated page)](https://glosx.app/ai-planner/): how the AI planner works, step by step
- [Explore routes](https://glosx.app/explore/): browse all covered routes and pick guides by email/WhatsApp
- [Route guides hub](https://glosx.app/rutas/): index of all individual route guides (e.g. Paris–Barcelona, Madrid–Seville, London–Paris)

## Blog

- [Blog index](https://glosx.app/blog.html): guides on European train travel — pricing, night trains, scenic routes, Eurail vs point-to-point, and more

## Languages

Available in English, Spanish (español neutro), French and Italian. Language-specific homepages: [/es/](https://glosx.app/es/), [/fr/](https://glosx.app/fr/), [/it/](https://glosx.app/it/).
